product_metadata.title: NISPOTDOR Portable Mini Air Conditioner, Personal Evaporative Air Cooler with 3 Wind Speed and Remote Control, Small Cooling Fan for Bedroom Home Office Dorm
features: FAST COOLING FAN: Personal air cooler pulls warm air from the room through its evaporative water filter to create your personal space with cool air. this is not only a simple conditioner, allows you to add ice or ice water into the tank to accelerate the cooling speed.

PORTABLE & REMOTE CONTROL: Our mini air cooler comes with compact design that you can carry it anywhere easily! It is very suitable for homes, offices, outdoor picnics, replaces your regular fan to help keep the temperature cooler than the fan ever did. it’s so cool because you can actually bring it with you anywhere you want, plug it in and have a cool air.

EASY TO SETUP: Just add water to water tank and plug in (rechargeable with your mobile or power bank), adjust 3 optional wind speeds with touch screen according to your needs. Plus you can add ice or water for an even cooler experience. Also you can adjust wind direction by hands into vertical rotation if you need for various occasions.

LED NIGHT LIGHT MODE: There are 7 different LED colors,choose your favourite one can help with the better sleep or other occasions, and can be used as a night light. The color changing in the water reservoir is fun to play with too.

COST EFFECTIVE & HEALLTHY: Instead of using the whole AC unit when we're in one room this saves so much on electricity! It keeps your personal room cool while consuming very little energy. Evaporative cooling is a natural way of air-conditioning, and our evaporative cooler is environment friendly to human.
description: Are you trying to stay cool and comfortable with low cost but effective?
Our personal ail cooler is ultra cool helper for your any personal space!

It isn't something that would effect the temp of the whole room but it works well as a personal air conditioner.  It`s VERY EASY TO USE our portable air conditioner. But be sure that your personal cooler is on the flat balanced surface to avoid any air conditioner tank leaking.
